## Aviation

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 8/10" aria-label="Importance 8 of 10">8</span> FlyDubai copilot attacks captain mid-flight, forces cockpit entry
A FlyDubai co-pilot attacked the captain mid-flight with a crash axe on September 25, 2026, during a Dubai-to-Tel Aviv flight. Passengers and crew subdued the attacker and diverted the Boeing 737 carrying 160–180 people to Saudi Arabia. UAE prosecutors characterized the incident as an attempted terrorist act.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>FlyDubai flight FZ1073, September 25, 2026</li>
<li>Co-pilot Hamam al-Hammami used crash axe and stabbed captain</li>
<li>Aircraft descended 16,000–17,000 feet in ~2 minutes</li>
<li>160–180 passengers aboard</li>
<li>Diverted to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia</li>
<li>Co-pilot barred from Omani airlines due to extremist concerns</li>
</ul>

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 8/10" aria-label="Importance 8 of 10">8</span> Brazil's Lula and Bolsonaro close campaigns before critical presidential election
Brazil holds a presidential election on October 6, 2026, between incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and right-wing candidates backed by supporters of imprisoned former President Bolsonaro. Both camps claim confidence in first-round victory, though polls suggest a runoff on October 25 is likely if neither secures an outright win.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Election date: October 6, 2026</li>
<li>Lula, age 80, closing campaign claiming record São Paulo turnout</li>
<li>Flávio Bolsonaro, age 45, son of imprisoned former president</li>
<li>Elder Bolsonaro serving 27-year sentence for 2022 election-overturn attempt</li>
<li>Runoff scheduled for October 25 if no first-round winner</li>
<li>Flávio under investigation in film-funding scandal involving biopic</li>
</ul>

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7.5/10" aria-label="Importance 7.5 of 10">7.5</span> Brazil holds polarized presidential election with Trump ally challenging Lula
Brazil held a polarized presidential election on October 4 with incumbent President Lula, 80, challenging Sen. Flávio Bolsonaro, 45, a Trump ally; nearly 159 million voters eligible; runoff scheduled October 25 if no candidate exceeds 50%, with Lula criticizing U.S. tariffs and Trump ties while Bolsonaro campaigns on White House proximity and rare mineral deals.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Lula vs Flávio Bolsonaro; runoff October 25 if neither wins &gt;50%</li>
<li>Nearly 159 million voters eligible; 10 other candidates expected small shares</li>
<li>Lula (4th nonconsecutive term, 7th presidential election) strengthened China ties</li>
<li>Bolsonaro campaigns on Trump administration trade deals for rare minerals</li>
<li>Brazil has up to 21 million tons rare earth minerals, second only to China</li>
</ul>

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 8/10" aria-label="Importance 8 of 10">8</span> Germany's Merz visits Kyiv under active Russian bombardment to pledge military support
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visited Kyiv unannounced during active Russian bombardment to pledge military support to Ukraine. Germany committed €1 billion in additional defense spending and pledged interceptor drones, long-range weapons, and two Patriot systems alongside Norway.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Merz traveled by special train amid Russian drone and missile attack</li>
<li>Nine people injured and power outages reported in Kyiv</li>
<li>Germany allocating €1 billion from approved budget for military aid</li>
<li>Additional €350 million for power plant reconstruction</li>
<li>Thousands of interceptor drones committed</li>
<li>Two additional Patriot systems via joint German-Norwegian decision</li>
</ul>
